parameters.description_en:
Instance ID.  

You must specify an instance ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.  
><notice>  
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).  
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:

><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
></notice>
